sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 44 = #43; Internal Quality Checks row 44 = #43; Deterministic Checks row 33 check-scoring-policy.py)
evidence: Hashes of tests/scoring.toml (95f70d6e...), tools/score.py (13de2b38...), test.sh (bd682592...) and all five judge.toml match manifest.json; scoring.toml, score.py and test.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff clean). scoring.toml:1-11 has [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0, [weights] 0.6/0.2/0.2 (gates absent from weights), [floors] functional=0.05. score.py:40-48: gates_passed requires every gate score > 0.0; scored dims are forced to 0 unless gates passed and scored/reward.json exists; reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed (functional > 0.05), else 0.0; weighted sum uses only [weights], so gates carry no mass. returns 1 on gate failure. test.sh:60-61 writes zero reward + EXIT trap first; 212 removes stale scored logs; 213-222 runs gates, exits with zero/detailed-zero on rewardkit failure, score.py exit 1 (gate fail) or other (error -> write_zero_reward) before the scored suite at 224; 227 rescoring failure writes zero. Both gate judge.toml use aggregation=all_pass with one binary criterion (render: real Kittle chat + no pre-sign-in leak + wrong password refused + Gwen signs in; constraints: post JUDGE-G1, survives reload, visible to Harriet in separate context), so a static shell/local-only facade fails the gate. Polish/visual/functional prompts each restate a global browser gate that zeros the dimension. Executed the frozen score.py (python -B, copies in scratchpad) on synthetic logs: render=0 -> reward 0, functional/polish/visual 0, exit 1; gates ok but no scored/reward.json -> reward 0; gates ok, functional 0.034 (one 1.5/44 criterion), polish=visual=1 -> weighted 0.4204 but reward 0.0, floors_passed 0; functional exactly 0.05 -> reward 0 (strict >); functional 0.0682 -> 0.4409; all 1 -> 1.0; missing gate key -> exit 2 (test.sh writes plain zero). Weak-app attempt: a server-backed chat that passes both gates plus perfect polish/visual but at most one small functional criterion (max single small weight 1.5/44=0.034 <= 0.05) earns 0 - no polish/visual farming. Conforming alternative: no gate arrangement here zeroes a working app for non-public reasons within this row's scope (gates only require sign-in and server-backed posting the brief mandates). Note (not a defect for this row): the 0.05 floor is template-fixed; an app passing the gates plus two 1.5-weight criteria (3/44=0.068) clears it and can collect ~0.44 from polish/visual. Such an app is working (persisting, cross-user chat with features), so the floor's stated purpose holds; weight-balance concerns belong to rows 42/44. Runtime scope: this was a deterministic execution of score.py with synthetic RewardKit outputs, not a full configured RewardKit/judge run; raw-evidence-index states no full configured grading run exists for these bytes. The gating path is shared template code, so the missing judge run does not leave this row's mechanism unverified.
